name: Building ChatGPT Skills for Business Professionals
description: Six-course learning path from LinkedIn Learning covering generative AI fundamentals, AI-powered research and writing, prompt engineering with ChatGPT, business applications of GPT, data analysis in Excel with ChatGPT, and ethical considerations of generative AI. Completed all 6 courses (7 hours) to build ChatGPT skills for business.

criteria.narrative: Completed all six courses in the Building ChatGPT Skills for Business Professionals learning path on LinkedIn Learning: What Is Generative AI?, How to Research and Write Using Generative AI Tools, Prompt Engineering with ChatGPT, Nano Tips for Using ChatGPT for Business with Rachel Woods, Excel and ChatGPT: Data Analysis Power Tips, and Ethics in the Age of Generative AI.
